newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Westpac cuts fixed mortgage rates.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Westpac cuts fixed mortgage rates.

text.p: Westpac Banking Corp Ltd on Friday announced reductions of up to 0.45 percentage points in interest rates on its fixed rate housing loans, effective October 21.
Westpac's two year home loan mortgage rate has been reduced by 0.25 percent points to 8.50 percent and its three year rate by the same amount to 8.75 percent.
Other new fixed rates are a special 7.5 percent for one year, 8.95 percent for four years (down 0.3 percent) and 9.15 percent (down 0.3 percent) for five years.
Home loans for investment have also been reduced.
